name: Ichiki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ichiki town emblem in black: a winged device with a pointed top above a ring with a vertical bar.
history: Flag of the former town of Ichiki in Kagoshima Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-10-11. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1960.

features.role: Ichiki town emblem — a winged device with a pointed top above a ring with a vertical bar
